mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`bar_level_title`(id, bar_id, level, title, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{barId}, #{level}, #{title}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update title = #{title}, update_time = #{updateTime}
mapper.select: select title from booknest.`bar_level_title` where bar_id = #{barId} and level = #{level}
